title: Seed bands
description: A cell and arm across its seeds: each second's honest q0.9 lag as bands over the seeds (p10–p90 light, p25–p75 dark, p50 line, max dotted) and the share of seeds unhealthy then; hovering shows each quantile at the second under the pointer. Align on the stream's start or on each run's first event of a kind (a departure, an uplink step, the verdict's onset or collapse); runs without one are left out.
